instruction: The precondition FreeCAD file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file in FreeCAD and create a Gmsh mesh from the given body using Frontal meshing, maximum element size 0.5 mm, minimum element size 0.1 mm, and angle 40 degrees. Save the completed document to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
